wins: Maintained consistent reward generation across the single episode, demonstrating stability in the agent's policy updates.
Managed 15 mentor calls without crashing, indicating resilience of the training loop under guided interventions.
fails: Zero percent success rate indicates failure to achieve mission-critical objective despite exploration.
Lack of progression beyond initial stages; no successful exploitation or data exfiltration recorded.
key_outcomes.summary: Stable reward trajectory but operationally ineffective—agent fails to complete mission tasks due to inability to translate reconnaissance into successful intrusion.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Reconnaissance data collected but no pivot to exploitation; repeated halt after initial enumeration phase.

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 22 is open and SSH service detected
skill_cards.then_action: Run SSH brute-force and key-check enumeration using nmap scripts

skill_cards.if_condition: After initial TCP connect scan reveals port 80 or 443
skill_cards.then_action: Launch web content discovery with dirb followed by nikto for vulnerability discovery

skill_cards.if_condition: When service banner includes outdated software version
skill_cards.then_action: Query exploit-db for matching vulnerabilities and prepare proof-of-concept payload

memory_ops.reason: SSH enumeration consistently triggered with open port 22 and provided actionable service data
Web enumeration steps yielded consistent reconnaissance outputs for HTTP/HTTPS targets
